title: Lost Vape Centaurus E40 Max Pod Vape Kit
description: The Lost Vape Centaurus E40 Max Pod Kit is a stunning blend of elegant design and innovative technology, built for vapers who value both style and performance. Featuring luxurious, supple leather panels complemented by a durable aluminium alloy frame, the Centaurus E40 Max exudes sophistication. The Roman column-inspired backlit panel adds a unique aesthetic touch, lighting up during charging to create a captivating, ‘breathing’ visual effect. Beneath its elegant exterior, the Centaurus E40 Max houses a powerful 1400mAh built-in battery, delivering a peak output of 40W. The advanced QUEST 2.0 chip ensures dynamic power management, adapting seamlessly to varying coil resistances for enhanced flavour and vapour production. A 0.42” OLED display provides a crisp, user-friendly interface for monitoring settings, while the adjustable airflow system allows users to fine-tune their vaping experience from MTL (mouth-to-lung) to RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) to DTL (direct-to-lung). The kit includes the innovative 2ml Lost Vape E-Plus Pod Cartridge, crafted with a leakproof structure and integrated coils. Designed for versatility, the kit comes with two coil options: a 0.3ohm cartridge for smooth DTL vaping with high-VG e-liquids and a 0.6ohm cartridge for a satisfying RDL or MTL experience with 50/50 and nic salt e-liquids. Combining luxurious, ergonomic design, robust, versatile performance, and cutting-edge features, the Lost Vape Centaurus E40 Max is a truly premium pod vape kit. Whether you’re drawn to its timeless aesthetic, dynamic functionality, or compact portability, this device offers everything you need to enjoy an exceptional vaping experience. Shop vape juice online and find the flavour that feels like it was made for this kit. We recommend using the following E-Liquid with these pods: 0.3ohm E Plus Pod use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid Only 0.6ohm E Plus Pod use 50/50 or Nic Salts E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
